title: PHP discloses a critical memory-management vulnerability, dubbed "PHP2Shell", that affects up to 70% of websites, discovered using GPT-5.6 Sol in August (Robert McMillan/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Robert McMillan / Wall Street Journal: PHP discloses a critical memory-management vulnerability, dubbed “PHP2Shell”, that affects up to 70% of websites, discovered using GPT-5.6 Sol in August — AI tools helped find one of the most severe online bugs ever. Cyber experts are racing to patch it before hackers use AI to exploit it.
